description: Story 3.5: the whole src/ tree is translated. no-literal-string is an error for every file matched by `files`, and `npm run i18n:check` checks them plus messages/*.json. `exceptions` lists technical text that is never shown to users: each entry skips only the string or template literals of `file` whose text matches `pattern` (a JavaScript regular expression). Nothing user-visible may be listed here.

exceptions.reason: GraphQL type definitions (SDL). Their # comments document the schema for developers and are never sent to users.
GLSL shader source compiled by WebGL. Its // comments are for developers and never rendered.
